pullRequest.body:
The first task/frame trace lost data and its final marker. Narrow the next observation to main-thread tasks, frames and explicit markers while preserving the original buffer, duration, stream-close and loss-detection limits. GPU/compositor coverage is explicitly reduced; this is an investigation, not a performance pass.

Keep historical declaration controls bound to their exact retained qualifier and recorder bytes. Repair replay reference execution by importing the original verified 47-module Node source from an owned temporary mirror: the changed localization catalog is frozen to its original bytes, the other 46 modules must match their original hashes, and all owned files are removed after success or failure. No runtime game, replay format, checkpoint, performance threshold or deadline changes.

Validation: independent source review and static formatting checks completed. Hosted controls must pass on the latest commit before merge or native observation. The initial replay source check failed 23/24 because current localization bytes differed from the historical reference; that failed result remains retained. Native trace v2 has not yet run.

controllerReview.workflow:
name: Fastline exact-head auto-merge

on:
  workflow_run:
    # Reconcile when any PR validation workflow completes, including a failure
    # that must disarm an earlier decision. The controller also waits for every
    # non-waived exact-head check already registered on the commit.
    workflows:
      - Validate source for continuous main
      - Appearance preview
      - Industrial feature verification
      - Company edition candidates
      - Assemble full-test release evidence
      - Community hosted acceptance
      - Community MinIO recovery
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types:
      [
        opened,
        reopened,
        synchronize,
        edited,
        labeled,
        unlabeled,
        milestoned,
        demilestoned,
        ready_for_review,
        converted_to_draft,
      ]
  pull_request_review:
    branches: [main]
    types: [submitted, dismissed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  checks: read
  actions: write

concurrency:
  group: fastline-merge-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number || github.run_id }}
  # Metadata changes are cheap and read current state. Serializing them avoids
  # cancelled controller checks poisoning GitHub's merge-state rollup.
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  reconcile:
    # Completed failed/cancelled required gates must also wake the controller:
    # an exact head that was armed by an earlier successful run must be
    # disarmed when the required result changes.
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'workflow_run' ||
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # This privileged controller checks out automation only from protected main.
      # It never checks out or executes pull-request code.
      - name: Check out trusted controller
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09 # v5
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml
            publishing/fastline-merge-controller.mjs
            publishing/admission-binding.mjs
            publishing/admission-preflight.mjs
            publishing/focused-tests.mjs
            publishing/focused-test-map.json
            publishing/test-policy.json
            publishing/test-policy.mjs
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: Record one-time controller bootstrap
        if: hashFiles('publishing/fastline-merge-controller.mjs') == ''
        run: echo 'Trusted controller is not on protected main yet; this bootstrap event is intentionally a no-op.'

      - name: Reconcile exact-head admission
        if: hashFiles('publishing/fastline-merge-controller.mjs') != ''
        env:
          ACTIVE_MILESTONE: ${{ vars.REVEALLINE_ACTIVE_RELEASE }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node publishing/fastline-merge-controller.mjs
findings: The all-green ready PR has not reached a newly completed controller invocation. Latest post-release controller is pending with no jobs; no policy refusal from it exists.

Older queued controller39163477326 has no runner/steps. Its association with this PR is inferred from the near-exact Industrial completion time, because the API omits the workflow_run parent event payload.

Current visible PR state, complete path receipt and policy bytes reveal no admission change; the actual controller still must perform fresh inventory/provenance and mutation-race checks. This source/data audit does not execute or bypass the controller.

candidate.producer: Successful Appearance39122543440; compact metadata and exact118-file source TAP independently verified. Full archive/source/worker/CSP admission remains required; no large payload downloaded during preparation.

boundaries.start: before action3 public #shell-featured click, after the existing warm-reloaded-ready snapshot
boundaries.end: request observer-only performance.mark after action7 safe-border-direction-3; stop only after its completion; do not await between active actions
boundaries.retention: Both unique raw trace markers required, same document/process/thread; record separate browser brackets and CDP round-trip uncertainty.

backend.reason: The existing fixed warm observer has no emitted renderer/GL identity. No new context, flags or graphics capability probe; retain this limitation.

limitations: 8 MiB buffer and 30-second trace are newly proposed tighter diagnostic caps; old CPU declarations keep traceBytes:0 and their sampling limits unchanged.
A watchdog requests stop at the cap; asynchronous browser completion is not guaranteed. A complete diagnostic additionally requires the stop request and the observed anchor window within the cap.
Warm recipe actions, fresh calibration, browser launch flags, viewport and package must be pinned independently before admission. No hardcoded HUD3.88 factor.
Trace does not establish physical presentation, OS scheduling, GPU completion or causality merely from temporal correlation.

The trace watchdog is armed at the Tracing.start request. Uncertain or late start acknowledgement and unconfirmed completion request closure of the existing row-owned browser; only each observed stream handle can be individually closed.
Trace setup consumes the original public Start action budget, with separate setup elapsed time retained. End-marker completion and stream export add no awaited active-action gap.

Exact9d first-eight remains failed: seven correctness rows passed and worker WebKit active-flight guard failed;14 owners closed and4 native replays passed. This separate failure investigation supplies no first-eight or numerical qualification.
No current797 result is rebound; historical CPU sampling declarations and their240000ms/traceBytes:0 settings remain unchanged.
The unchanged traced interval covers first3s after public Start, not later terminal-HUD spans or a whole-session performance claim.

This separately named successor removes broad cc, viz and gpu categories and preserves every original cap and strict loss/anchor requirement. It has reduced cross-process graphics coverage; categories can overlap, so cross-tagged events may still appear.

The failed v1 trace and exact executed declarations remain retained. Filtering the surviving v1 event names is not a measurement of v2 byte cost and does not guarantee that the same buffer will be sufficient.
Any data loss, missing raw anchor, missing EOF or unsuccessful stream closure/CDP detach remains a failed diagnostic; no automatic fallback, retry, larger budget or performance pass is admitted.

workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      lane:
        description: 'Fixed797 qualification lanes; later phases require reviewed predecessors or separate Cocoa codec control. Review exact source before expansion; no automatic retries.'
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: first-eight
        options:
          [
            first-eight,
            next,
            cocoa,
            raster,
            hud-cpu,
            readiness,
            touch,
            app-overhead,
            journal-cost,
            timing,
            lifecycle,
            shared-return,
            demo-recovery,
            demo-resources,
            replay-portability,
            frame-trace,
          ]

      phase:
        description: 'One fixed timing or lifecycle phase; ignored by other lanes. No automatic continuation.'
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: none
        options:
          [
            none,
            cold-first30,
            warm-first30,
            sentry-latency,
            long-rail-latency,
            large-capture-erosion,
            jammer-steering,
            retry,
            soak,
            long29,
          ]

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: solo-native-de332-${{ inputs.lane || 'first-eight' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

hud-cpu:
    if: github.repository == 'mekhovov/revealline' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && (inputs.lane == 'hud-cpu' || inputs.lane == 'frame-trace')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 130
    env:
      SOLO_TOOLING_REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
      SOLO_BASELINE_SOURCE: ${{ github.workspace }}/baseline
      SOLO_CANDIDATE_SOURCE: ${{ github.workspace }}/candidate
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: 1
      SOLO_DIAGNOSTIC_LANE: ${{ inputs.lane }}
      SOLO_DIAGNOSTIC_OUTPUT: ${{ inputs.lane == 'frame-trace' && 'solo-linux-9d5139-frame-tasks-v2' || 'solo-linux-797e03-hud-cpu' }}
    steps:
      - timeout-minutes: 2
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09 # v5
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: tools
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 1
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /docs/performance/solo-browser-frame-trace-9d-tasks-plan.json
            /scripts/solo-frame-trace-tasks-admission.test.mjs
            /scripts/solo-frame-trace-executed-source.mjs
            /docs/performance/fixtures/solo-browser-frame-trace/fd787-executed-source.json
            /docs/performance/solo-browser-frame-trace-9d-failure-plan.json
            /scripts/solo-frame-trace-failure-admission.test.mjs
            /docs/performance/fixtures/solo-browser-frame-trace/83f-held-source.json
            /scripts/solo-shared-owner-declared-source.mjs
            /docs/performance/fixtures/solo-shared-mode/91b-owner-declared-source.json
            /docs/performance/solo-remote-9d5139b-correctness-plan.json
            /docs/performance/fixtures/solo-readiness-797e03/9aaf-declared-tooling-source.json
            /scripts/solo-readiness-rejoin-declared-source.mjs
            /.github/workflows/solo-native-package-consumer.yml

- timeout-minutes: 3
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09 # v5
        with:
          ref: 8b01991942dc764b8aa4726851699ce1985e53ae
          path: baseline
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Materialize the exact candidate from the shared source object store
        timeout-minutes: 3
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-linux-setup"
          case "$SOLO_DIAGNOSTIC_LANE" in
            frame-trace)
              bash tools/scripts/solo-shared-source-checkout.sh 8b01991942dc764b8aa4726851699ce1985e53ae 9373b6a74aea8fa1ef47aa17ace140b4cf714609 9d5139b9983c700a6a708f65f379fa4d5a8b0395 99f9e6cea7ea7dc27c93609aae632908531d93d1 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-linux-setup/source-checkout.json"
              ;;
            hud-cpu)
              bash tools/scripts/solo-shared-source-checkout.sh 8b01991942dc764b8aa4726851699ce1985e53ae 9373b6a74aea8fa1ef47aa17ace140b4cf714609 797e03f28743921842df6aa57520a72016ba3dfc bd53120f0cdfa462b8d63c2de5aa61e9c6658ac5 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-linux-setup/source-checkout.json"
              ;;
            *) exit 2 ;;
          esac
      - timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444 # v5
        with:
          node-version: '22.13.1'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Record setup and install exact source dependencies
        timeout-minutes: 10
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf '%s\n' \
            "SOLO_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-browser-tools/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs" \
            "PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-browser-binaries" \
            "OUTPUT=$RUNNER_TEMP/$SOLO_DIAGNOSTIC_OUTPUT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-linux-setup"
          test "$(git -C tools rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOLO_TOOLING_REVISION"
          npm ci --prefix tools --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | head -c 4194304 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-linux-setup/tools-npm.log"
      - name: Install the separately pinned browser cohort
        timeout-minutes: 10
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-browser-tools"
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-browser-tools" --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts --save-exact playwright@1.62.1 2>&1 | head -c 4194304 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-linux-setup/browser-install.log"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-browser-tools/node_modules/.bin/playwright" install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | head -c 4194304 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-linux-setup/browser-dependencies.log"
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-browser-tools/package-lock.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-linux-setup/browser-package-lock.json"
      - name: Exercise archive rejection and owned timeout cleanup
        timeout-minutes: 3
        working-directory: tools
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --test --test-concurrency=2 scripts/solo-frame-trace-tasks-admission.test.mjs scripts/test-solo-first-victory-cpu-797e03.mjs scripts/test-solo-native-consumer-current.mjs scripts/test-solo-first-victory-cpu-de332.mjs scripts/test-solo-remote-correctness.mjs scripts/test-solo-remote-baseline.mjs scripts/test-solo-final-long-rail-cpu-profile.mjs scripts/test-solo-qualification-replay-identity.mjs scripts/test-solo-source-verifier-smoke.mjs scripts/test-solo-qualification-next-route.mjs scripts/test-solo-first-victory-cpu-profile.mjs scripts/test-solo-first-victory-cpu-239.mjs 2>&1 | head -c 4194304 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-linux-setup/wrapper-tests.tap"
          case "$SOLO_DIAGNOSTIC_LANE" in
            frame-trace)
              node scripts/solo-remote-cpu-profile.mjs bind-plan docs/performance/solo-browser-frame-trace-9d-tasks-plan.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-cpu-profile-job.json"
              ;;
            hud-cpu)
              node scripts/solo-remote-cpu-profile.mjs bind-plan docs/performance/solo-first-victory-cpu-797e03-plan.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-cpu-profile-job.json"
              ;;
            *) exit 2 ;;
          esac
      - name: Run only this reviewed phase and fixed source pair
        timeout-minutes: 78
        working-directory: tools
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 4620s node scripts/run-solo-remote-correctness.mjs "$RUNNER_TEMP/solo-cpu-profile-job.json" "$OUTPUT"

- name: Retain all complete, failed and partial evidence
        if: ${{ always() }}
        timeout-minutes: 10
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
        with:
          name: ${{ env.SOLO_DIAGNOSTIC_OUTPUT }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/${{ env.SOLO_DIAGNOSTIC_OUTPUT }}/evidence/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/solo-linux-setup/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          compression-level: 6
          retention-days: 14
